summary: Setting up a GitHub webhook, part 1: generate a classic personal access token with repo:status, repo_deployment and public_repo scopes, optionally store it as a GitHub credential, select the webhook service and credential on the job template, then open the repository's Settings > Webhooks > Add webhook.
questions: How do I set up a GitHub webhook for a job template?
Which scopes does the GitHub PAT need for controller webhooks?
How does controller post job status back to GitHub?
